content: 9front arm64 mmu model: TTBR0 per-process (m->mmutop, L1TOPSIZE top table, ASID in TTBR bits 48+ via setttbr((uvlong)asid<<48 | PADDR(mmutop))), TTBR1 shared kernel L1 table. PTLEVELS parameterized (EVASHIFT=36, PGSHIFT=12, PTSHIFT=9, 3 levels). PTE bits: PTEVALID/PTEBLOCK/PTETABLE/PTEPAGE/PTEAF/PTEAP(user/kern)/PTEUXN/PTEPXN/PTESH/PTEDEVICE. Kernel text at KTZERO=VDRAM+0x100000; Mach arrays just below KTZERO (MACHADDR(n)=KTZERO-(n+1)*8KiB); m in TPIDR_EL1 and R27; up in R26; SB=R28. Boot: mmuidmap(L1BOT) identity-maps DRAM on TTBR0, mmu0init(L1) builds kernel high map, mmuenable switches to virtual. Per-proc page tables tracked as p->mmuhead[PTLEVELS] chains with p->mmufree freelist (DIFFERS from Harvey k10 PMMU=mmuptp[4]).
